guide.canDo1: Answers questions about your work from what Stave observed, even before you add a repository.
guide.canDo2: Turns an explicit request into bounded work in a registered workspace, with acceptance criteria.
guide.canDo3: Runs it in a new workspace of that repository, on a branch named by the repository's naming rule, with an agent team, an independent review and a verification.
guide.canDo4: Asks you to decide with a card you answer by click, number key or a short word.
guide.canDo5: Follows up by itself when work blocks, asks you or cannot be verified.
guide.canDo6: Shows each result's report, changes, timeline and review beside the conversation.
guide.limit1: Commits, pushes and opens a draft pull request only after you confirm its card each time; never merges or deploys.
guide.limit2: Works only while Stave is open and this computer is awake.
guide.limit3: Starts independent work concurrently. Set Concurrent responsibilities in Settings to add a limit; 0 adds no cap.
guide.limit4: Starts from the workspace's branch unless you turn on Include my working changes for that message; ignored files are never included.
guide.limit5: Uses Claude Code or Codex, and only saved agents you allowed in settings.
guide.limit6: Calls work done only with a check Stave saw pass or a passed review; otherwise it asks you.
guide.example1: What is running right now, and does anything need me?
guide.example2: In the web workspace, fix the flaky date-picker test. Done means its test passes.
guide.example3: Pause the date-picker work and show me what changed.
